title: Velocity.
officialText:
The minimum average velocity through a fixed opening shall not be less than:
v = 217.2 [h(T - T )/(T f+ 460)]1/2 (Equation 5-3)
f o
For SI: v = 119.9 [h(T - T )/T f]1/2
f o
where:
H = Height of opening, feet (m).
T = Temperature of smoke, °F (K).
f
T = Temperature of ambient air, °F (K).
o
v = Air velocity, feet per minute (m/minute).
